USE [thienhaso_ERP_Stock_AKP_2026]
GO
/****** Object:  StoredProcedure [dbo].[ACC_Receipt_BaoCaoThucHienTheoKhachHang]    Script Date: 26/08/2026 15:38:00 ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
SET QUOTED_IDENTIFIER ON
GO

/*
	Báo cáo doanh thu thực hiện theo khách hàng theo tháng
	Nguồn: SMS_OutputVoucherDetail.PlanQuantity * SMS_OutputVoucherDetail.OutputPrice
	Ngày lọc: SMS_OutputVoucher.OutputDate
*/
Alter Procedure [dbo].[ACC_Receipt_BaoCaoThucHienTheoKhachHang]
(
	@OfficeID int = null,
	@FromDate datetime,
	@ToDate datetime = null
)
As
Begin

	If @ToDate Is Null Set @ToDate = Getdate()

	---------------- Danh sách tháng -------------
	Declare @date datetime, @i int

	Select
		Month(@FromDate) as "Month",
		Year(@FromDate) as "Year",
		1 as OrderIndex
	Into #tblMonth

	Set @date = Dateadd(month, 1, @FromDate)
	Set @i = 2

	While Year(@date) < Year(@ToDate) or (Year(@date) = Year(@ToDate) and Month(@date) <= Month(@ToDate))
	Begin
		Insert #tblMonth
		Values
		(
			Month(@date),
			Year(@date),
			@i
		)
		Set @date = Dateadd(month, 1, @date)
		Set @i = @i + 1
	End

	Set @ToDate = @ToDate + 1

	----------- Tìm khách hàng theo điều kiện ---------------
	Select
		PartnerID
	Into #tblPartner
	From CRM_Partner
	Where IsDeleted = 0
		and IsIgnoreReport = 0

	----------- Doanh thu phiếu xuất trong khoảng thời gian ---------------
	Select
		SMS_OutputVoucher.OutputVoucherID,
		SMS_OutputVoucher.OutputDate,
		SMS_OutputVoucher.PartnerID,
		Isnull(SMS_OutputVoucherDetail.PlanQuantity, 0) * Isnull(SMS_OutputVoucherDetail.OutputPrice, 0) as PlanTotalMoney
	Into #tblOutputVoucher
	From SMS_OutputVoucher
		Inner Join SMS_Store on SMS_Store.StoreID = SMS_OutputVoucher.OutputStoreID
		Inner Join SMS_OutputVoucherDetail on SMS_OutputVoucherDetail.OutputVoucherID = SMS_OutputVoucher.OutputVoucherID
	Where SMS_OutputVoucher.IsDeleted = 0
		and SMS_OutputVoucher.IsCanceled = 0
		and SMS_OutputVoucher.PartnerID Is Not Null
		and (@OfficeID Is Null or SMS_Store.OfficeID = @OfficeID)
		and SMS_OutputVoucher.OutputDate >= @FromDate
		and SMS_OutputVoucher.OutputDate < @ToDate

	----------- Doanh thu thực hiện theo tháng (dàn cột) ---------------
	Select
		tblOutputVoucher.PartnerID,
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 1 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_1",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 2 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_2",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 3 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_3",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 4 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_4",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 5 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_5",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 6 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_6",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 7 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_7",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 8 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_8",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 9 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_9",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 10 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_10",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 11 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_11",
		Sum(Case When #tblMonth.OrderIndex = 12 Then tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney Else 0 End) as "DoanhThu_12",
		Sum(tblOutputVoucher.PlanTotalMoney) as "TongDoanhThu"
	Into #tblDoanhThu
	From #tblPartner
		Inner Join #tblOutputVoucher tblOutputVoucher on tblOutputVoucher.PartnerID = #tblPartner.PartnerID
		Inner Join #tblMonth on #tblMonth.Year = Year(tblOutputVoucher.OutputDate)
			and #tblMonth.Month = Month(tblOutputVoucher.OutputDate)
	Group By tblOutputVoucher.PartnerID

	Drop Table #tblOutputVoucher
	Drop Table #tblMonth

	----------- Main select ------------
	Select
		CRM_Partner.PartnerID,
		CRM_Partner.PartnerCode,
		CRM_Partner.PartnerName,
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_1, 0) as "DoanhThu_1",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_2, 0) as "DoanhThu_2",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_3, 0) as "DoanhThu_3",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_4, 0) as "DoanhThu_4",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_5, 0) as "DoanhThu_5",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_6, 0) as "DoanhThu_6",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_7, 0) as "DoanhThu_7",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_8, 0) as "DoanhThu_8",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_9, 0) as "DoanhThu_9",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_10, 0) as "DoanhThu_10",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_11, 0) as "DoanhThu_11",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.DoanhThu_12, 0) as "DoanhThu_12",
		Isnull(tblDoanhThu.TongDoanhThu, 0) as "TongDoanhThu"
	From #tblPartner
		Inner Join CRM_Partner on CRM_Partner.PartnerID = #tblPartner.PartnerID
		Left Join #tblDoanhThu tblDoanhThu on tblDoanhThu.PartnerID = CRM_Partner.PartnerID
	Order By CRM_Partner.OrderIndex, CRM_Partner.PartnerName

	Drop Table #tblPartner
	Drop Table #tblDoanhThu

End

	Order By SMS_Item.OrderIndex, SMS_Item.ItemName
